title: Похищение Кости людьми Степана Андреевича  (Kostya's Abduction by Stepan Andreyevich's Men)

segments.t: Stepping outside the restaurant, Kostya is grabbed by two burly men and bundled into the back of a black SUV. Bracing himself for revenge, Kostya defiantly declares his love for Nastya—only to find Nastya's father sitting inside with a bandaged nose, ordering him to attend their family dinner for Nastya's sake.
А я все равно буду с Настей.
А ты ударил меня разок по носу.

'Hey, guys, what do you think you are doing?' Nastya raises the pitch on 'what' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
'Do you know who I am?' The grammar packs 'you' and 'know' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Nastya answers right away.
'Are you trying to scare me?' In Russian, the idea of 'to scare' flows naturally into 'you want' without extra filler words.
'I am not afraid of you.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'am afraid' in spoken Russian.
'You can do whatever you want to me.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'can' before landing on 'all'. Vika answers right away.
'Anything you want.' The grammar packs 'what' and 'you want' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.

'And I will still stay with Nastya no matter what.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'Nastya'.
'Are you taking me out to the woods?' Vika raises the pitch on 'the forest' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Nastya answers right away.
'For family dinner.' The meaning hinges on 'on' working together with 'lunch' in spoken Russian.
'I do not like you one bit.' Vika anchors the line on 'not', while 'for me' completes the thought.
'And she came rushing right over to see me.' Notice how Russian expresses 'both' and 'have come' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Vika answers right away.

'All because you punched me once in the nose.' The grammar packs 'and' and 'nose' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Please forgive me once again.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'excuse me' before landing on 'time'. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
